message: The other night, I accidentally burned dinner (again). Instead of panicking, I grabbed some snacks, lit a few candles, and turned it into a little picnic on the living room floor while we waited for the smoke to clear. It reminded me how important it is to have a plan for those cooking mishaps—like a fire escape route—just in case. But hey, at least we had a cozy evening out of it! Have you ever turned a mishap into a fun memory?
